aiSummary: 今日聚焦国际政治领域。热点议题包括：Iran steps up diplomatic outreach；Singapore Adds 8 New Occupations；Paraguay’s ousted president charged over。本日共收录 8 条重要国际新闻。

articles.description: Iran steps up diplomatic outreach as Araghchi contacts 12 foreign ministers; Tehran warns US of a “devastating response” if war resumes.

articles.title: Singapore Adds 8 New Occupations to Work Permit List, Sets Salary and Hiring Conditions
articles.description: Singapore widened access to work permit system, opening new opportunities for foreign workers in additional sectors while employers prepare to adjust hiring plans.

articles.title: Paraguay’s ousted president charged over banking scandal
articles.description: Santiago Pena was impeached over the collapse of Ueno Bank, which left millions unable to access their accounts.

articles.title: Woman finds dead baby in relative's basement freezer as police investigate
articles.description: The body was found in a basement apartment in western Spain

articles.title: Pope Leo urges South America to bridge divides on Uruguay stop of 12-day tour
articles.description: Leo urged South American countries to ​set an example ⁠for international cooperation.

articles.title: Year Residence Permit for Parents of Golden Visa Investors
articles.description: Dubai has published the cost and four application steps for Golden Visa investors seeking a 10-year residence permit for their parents to live in the UAE.

articles.title: US offers $20m reward for information about Iran's nuclear programme
articles.description: Donald Trump has repeatedly raised the prospecting of renewing strikes against Iran's nuclear facilities.

articles.title: With an ode to mate, Pope Leo urges faithful in Uruguay to build bridges of fraternity and faith
articles.description: More than 30,000 people — many from Uruguay but also from neighboring Argentina and Brazil — had registered in advance to attend the service. The Vatican said Saturday that another 10,000 had attended
